output.subject: We've received your complaint about signing in to the app
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for contacting us. We're sorry for the frustration this has caused, especially when it affects your everyday banking.

We have received your complaint. You told us that since the app updated on 9/26, you haven't been able to log in and you see the message "We couldn't verify your device." You mentioned that the verification code is being sent to a phone number you haven't had since 2019, and that resetting your password three times hasn't helped. You also told us this means you can't see your balance or pay your bills, and that when you call, the phone line keeps directing you back to the app.

We understand that you'd like to get back into your account and have your verification codes sent to your current number.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer reports being unable to pay bills; check for upcoming or missed payments and decide whether faster contact is needed before the 10-day window.
The customer has not given a current phone number; decide how to reach them and verify their identity before any contact details are changed.
Decide whether to offer an interim way to check their balance or make payments while app access is blocked.
Customer says phone support keeps redirecting them to the app; check whether this needs follow-up with the phone team.
Check whether other customers are reporting login or verification problems since the 9/26 app update.
Customer asked to have app access restored and the verification phone number updated; no outcome has been promised in the draft.
